title: Digital Rights & Cyber Law Scholarship
shortDescription: For law students specializing in technology policy, privacy rights, and cyber security regulations.
description: This scholarship supports the next generation of legal experts in the digital age. We value **experience** in legal clinics focused on digital rights or tech policy research. **Career goals** should target shaping internet legislation or defending digital privacy. **Achievements** like moot court victories in tech law or published legal reviews are highly regarded. **Extracurricular activities** such as participation in hackathons (legal track) or membership in digital rights organizations are encouraged.
requirements: GPA 3.5+. **Experience** with technology policy or cyber law. **Achievements** in legal writing or advocacy. **Extracurricular activities** relevant to digital rights. **Career goals** focusing on the intersection of law and technology.
benefits: $20,000 for tuition and bar prep. **Benefits** include a clerkship with a leading digital rights NGO to advance your **career goals**. You will gain **experience** drafting policy briefs. Highlighting your **achievements** at our annual legal tech summit.
fields: Law, Public Policy, Cyber Security, Political Science
requiredAcademicAwards: Moot Court Winner, Legal Review Publication
